description: The portfolio's Renovate configuration lives in sborka and is extended by name, so this repository stops being one more copy to keep in step.

Most of the preset is inert here — there is no Gradle build, so the kotlin, kotlinx and sborka groups match nothing. What does apply is the part this repository actually needs: one Monday batch, `ci actions` as one pull request instead of one per action (#2, #3 and #5 are three pull requests for one question — does the check still pass), majors labelled and left to a human, and vulnerability alerts off-schedule.

Automerge is a separate preset (`github>youndie/sborka:automerge-harness`) and is not extended here: nothing merges itself today. Its precondition holds — check.yaml runs on `pull_request` — and this is a likelier candidate than most, since the harness is nearly all this repository has to update.
